         6                  THE SECRETARY:    By Senator Bruno,

         7       Legislative Resolution Number 4146,

         8       recognizing February 8, 2008, as "Blue

         9       Friday."

        10                  "WHEREAS, The State of New York

        11       takes great pride in participating in

        12       significant days of recognition; and

        13                  "WHEREAS, Albany radio station WGNA

        14       has teamed up with the Capital District

        15       Chapter of Concerns of Police Survivors,

        16       Inc. -- COPS -- in recognizing February 8,

        17       2008, as "Blue Friday," in honor of all law

        18       enforcement officers who have given their

        19       lives in the line of duty, as well as all

        20       those still serving; and

        21                  "WHEREAS, COPS, organized in 1984

        22       with approximately 110 members, has grown into

        23       a nationwide nonprofit organization with 48

        24       chapters throughout the United States and an

        25       affiliate in the United Kingdom.  Its mission



                      Candyco Transcription Service, Inc.
                                (518) 371-8910

                                                        267



         1       is to help rebuild the lives of survivors of

         2       law enforcement officers killed in the line of

         3       duty by serving as a clearinghouse for federal

         4       and state benefits information and resources

         5       that may be available to the surviving

         6       families; and

         7                  "WHEREAS, COPS also provides

         8       training to law enforcement agencies on

         9       survivor victimization issues and educates the

        10       public of the need to support the law

        11       enforcement profession and its survivors; and

        12                  "WHEREAS, Each year, between 140

        13       and 160 officers are killed in the line of

        14       duty, and their families and coworkers are

        15       left to cope with the tragic loss; and

        16                  "WHEREAS, Today's COPS membership,

        17       including spouses, children, parents,

        18       siblings, significant others, and coworkers of

        19       officers killed in the line of duty, consists

        20       of more than 12,000 families; and

        21                  "WHEREAS, February 8th is a

        22       reminder to pay tribute to those in the law

        23       enforcement community who has made the

        24       ultimate sacrifice; and

        25                  "WHEREAS, On February 8, 2008, from



                      Candyco Transcription Service, Inc.
                                (518) 371-8910

                                                        268



         1       6:00 a.m. until 10:00 a.m., WGNA, DeNooyer

         2       Chevrolet and COPS will be taking a Donation

         3       for a Carnation, selling blue carnations and

         4       special edition "Blue Friday" T-shirts at both

         5       DeNooyer Chevrolet in Colonie, New York, and

         6       Pizzeria Uno, Saratoga Springs, New York.

         7       Over 25 agencies will be represented at the

         8       two locations, and all proceeds will go

         9       directly to COPS; and

        10                  "WHEREAS, The State of New York is

        11       eternally grateful for the service of its

        12       brave men and women in law enforcement, and

        13       applauds the efforts of COPS to assist the

        14       families of those who have made the ultimate

        15       sacrifice; now, therefore, be it

        16                  "RESOLVED, That this Legislative

        17       Body pause in its deliberations to recognize

        18       February 8, 2008, as "Blue Friday"; and be it

        19       further

        20                  "RESOLVED, That copies of this

        21       resolution, suitably engrossed, be transmitted

        22       to WGNA and COPS."

        24       question is on the resolution.  All in favor

        25       signify by saying aye.

        15                  I rise -- Senator Bruno wished to

        16       be here, because it's a resolution by both of

        20       hearts of all New Yorkers, there's not a

        21       single act of bravery greater than the men and

        22       women of law enforcement who have made the

        23       ultimate sacrifice and died in the line of

        24       duty, protecting the safety and the lives of

        25       others.

         1                  You know, this is a wonderful thing

         6       them all to you.

         8       which is a local radio station --

         9       incidentally, it is the number-one radio

        10       station in this area, and one that I listen to

        11       all the time and every morning.

        12                  And with us today, we have officer

        13       and president of COPS Pat Fox, retired from

        14       the Albany Police.  Also, Bob Fitzgerald,

        15       who's not with us here today, he's vice

        16       president.

        19       president.  Bob?  And also Tom Jacobson, the

        24       Phillips, the great Richie Phillips, who does

        25       a thing on the Senate and the Assembly and

         1       legislators; and of course Casey Danton, who

         2       also works with them.  Casey?  And also with

         3       us we have Selena Dutcher, the marketing

         4       director.

         5                  We're very, very pleased that this

         6       Friday, at DeNooyer Chevrolet and up at

         7       Pizzeria Uno, they will be selling blue

         8       carnations and T-shirts on behalf of COPS.

         9                  And we thank you for your service.

        10       We thank you for what you're doing for fallen

        11       police officers.  Everybody in this Senate and

        12       in this Legislature in general is thrilled and

        13       pleased to honor you because of all the

        14       service that these police officers have given.

        15                  And every day, their lives are in

        16       danger.  We've had so many tragedies, even

        17       this year I think in the double figures, 10 or

        18       12 that have also given their lives.

        19                  With that, Mr. President, I support

        20       the resolution.
